question: Inland streams which do NOT drain out into sea are generally found in which state of India?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Rajasthan__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Inland streams **which do **not drain **out into the **sea **are generally found in the **Rajasthan **state of **India**.
 
• An Inland stream is a stream in which rivers do not reach an ocean or sea but empty their waters in a lake or an inland sea.
 
• Rivers Luni, Ghaggar, Rupnarain, Medha, etc have inland drainage.
 
• The Ghaggar is the most important river of inland drainage.
 
• It is a seasonal stream that rises on the lower slopes of the Himalayas and forms a boundary between Haryana and Punjab.
 
• It gets lost in the **dry sands **of **Rajasthan **near **Hanumangarh **after **traversing **a **distance **of 465 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
